sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 41.6 grams of fat. Polyunsaturated fat is 28.5 grams, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling. Omega 3 is 100 milligrams, not adding much omega 3, so that's a real downside for seeds. For seeds, fat quality is a big reason to use them.
